name: Modmail bot
description: Threads, notes and block list stored by the Modmail bot ([kyb3r/modmail](https://github.com/modmail-dev/modmail)) in its MongoDB database `modmail_bot`. Discord IDs are stored as strings.

instructions: Open a MongoDB shell on the bot's database:

steps.title: Delete persistent staff notes about them
instructions: Persistent notes (`?note persistent`) are attached to the person and shown again in every new thread they open.

steps.title: Block list: kept by default
instructions: If the person is blocked, the block entry is **kept for moderation purposes**. Note it in the result summary so the requester is told what was kept and why.

The reason should be short and factual (e.g. "Harassment of staff"). If it contains more (quotes, opinions, details about other people…), replace it with a factual one: `?unblock` the person, then `?block` them again with the shorter reason.

steps.title: Outside MongoDB
instructions: The database is not the only copy. On Discord, the bot also left:
- the old **thread channels**, if they were not deleted when closed;
- the **log channel** messages (embeds) summarizing each closed thread;
- **attachments** sent in threads, which stay on Discord's CDN.
Delete them by hand if needed, and mention it in the result summary.
